text: Don't know!!!! Never used it.. My puppy was potty trained by the time I received this LOL. I was able to train my golden retriever potty train him by 3 months and 1 week old!!! I ordered this a little too late. Prior to this I was using plastic on my floor and newspapers. Thank God he is potty trained what a nightmare that was. Now my condo smells fresh and clean. Again. Make sure you get outside often with a puppy that's the trick you've got to get outdoors every time he drinks water or when he wakes up. That's the way to do it. Now we can hold it for several hours and sleeps all night long. And he's 5 months old now

description: Protect your floor by using the Multi-Purpose Indoor & Outdoor Waterproof Tray. This item has a lightweight design that makes it easy for you to move it from one place to another. The boot and shoe tray is big enough to place multiple pairs of shoes on, yet compact enough to not take up too much space. The unit can be used for gardening, pets, shoes, painting and much more. This multi-purpose tray comes in black color. It's made with durable polypropylene and a raised edge to keep your floor clean. It can come in handy on days when the weather is bad and your shoes are wet and muddy. Place it near an entry in your home or carry it over to your garden or craft area to help with any activity.
